comment: uhitm.c hmon_hitmon_misc_obj(), an ordinary egg hitting a monster whose touch petrifies (lines 1232-1243): a Samurai in debug mode raises himself to experience level 14 with #levelchange, wishes for three eggs, creates a cockatrice beside him with ^G, wields the eggs and hits it with F (the eggs turn to rocks), then wishes for two more eggs and throws them at it one at a time (both miss on this seed). Seed, date, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
